title: Near, far: Patch-ordering enhances vision foundation models' scene understanding (NeCo)
mechanism: Dense post-pretraining that enforces consistent nearest-neighbour rankings of patch features between student and teacher via differentiable sorting; 19 GPU-h.
adaptation: Run on DINOv2-reg or DINOv3 ViT-B/L with pool cells at 448-518 px (1-ch repeated to 3) before D24's VFM fine-tune.
min_experiment: Arm: D24 DINOv3 ViT-B arm after NeCo on pool. Baseline: same arm without NeCo. Kill if E1 crack recall and out-of-fold relF1@2 both < +0.01.
evidence: R: +5.5 ADE20k and +6 Pascal in-context seg; +7.2 COCO-Things, +5.7 COCO-Stuff linear seg.
prior_overlap: None; BRIEF 5 tested only frozen linear probes and one ConvNeXt-T fine-tune screen.
